Pre-call materials I uploaded to the drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-cedartech-sig-prep

- redwood-logs-sample.txt (sanitized sample of request logs and retention note)

Top 5 topics I plan to cover on the call (so CedarTech can invite SMEs if needed):
1) Tenant isolation and per-customer log separation — how we segregate KV cache and raw request logs.
2) Data encryption (at-rest using KMS/HSM options and in-transit TLS) + key rotation cadence.
3) Evidence access model and uploads — support for signed S3 presigned URLs or Drive link.
4) Retention policies and the playbook for exporting logs for audits (90/180/365 day options).
5) SOC 2 mapping: which of our artifacts are in the SOC 2 evidence pack vs. ad-hoc exports.

Attachments for the call: redwood-proof-of-concept-logs-sample.txt (small) and our evidence mapping.xlsx (I put a stub in the Drive folder).

- Marissa: run through CAIQ mapping and present control owners (Drive)
- Ben: demo how to generate a scoped log export and show a sanitized sample
- Dylan: coordinate post-call delivery timeline and follow-ups with CedarTech procurement if needed

See you on Tue.
Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@cedartech.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call — CedarTech SIG/CAIQ intake notes and next steps

Hi all — quick notes and owners from today's intake (thanks to CedarTech for the honest prioritization).

Summary (45m): we covered control mapping, evidence handoff route, and three technical deep-dive asks.

Key answers and references:
- Tenant separation: Redwood maintains per-tenant logical separation. Raw request logs are partitioned by customer-id and can be exported as gzipped text. (See redwood-proof-of-concept-logs-sample.txt in Drive).
- Encryption: data at-rest is encrypted using customer-managed KMS (optional). Key rotation is configurable; default rotation policy is 90 days for ephemeral keys, 365 for long-lived keys.
- Retention & export: standard retention tiers offered are 90 / 180 / 365 days. We can provide one-time snapshots for audits; Ben to demonstrate export flow.
- SOC 2 artifacts: the SOC 2 evidence pack covers infra-level controls; CAIQ-specific evidence (config snapshots, policy configs) will be provided as separate exports.

Action grid (owner — ETA):
- Ben Carter — produce a scoped log export demo and a sanitized 24-hour sample (by Fri 30 Apr).
- Marissa Cole — finalize CAIQ control mapping spreadsheet and flag any controls requiring engineering sign-off (by Mon 3 May).
- Dylan Brooks — coordinate CedarTech follow-up and share procurement checklist + handoff window options (by Mon 3 May).
- Alice / CedarTech — confirm preferred artifact upload method (Drive link vs. SFTP) and provide a prioritized list of CAIQ questions to close in the next handoff (by Mon 3 May).

Attachments: redwood-evidence-runbook.pdf, redwood-proof-of-concept-logs-sample.txt (links in Drive).

If anyone sees a missing item or a misplaced owner, please flag and I'll update.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
